items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: It was my lullaby when Moe's Junior was a baby

ctx.x: See we're recording today in Tippo Mississippi at the home of Mr. and Mrs. Moe's Allison Sr. and today's date is May the 24th 1960 so let's get your name on here first

Yes your name go ahead Maxine Allison I see and you used to sing this song we wanted? Oh it was my lullaby when Moe's Junior was a baby It was handed down from my husband's father who used to sing it to him as a little boy
